tools.name: google_ads_list_accounts
tools.description: List all Google Ads MCCs and ALL customer accounts the OAuth token can access (via customers:listAccessibleCustomers — not just hierarchy of the MCC). Each customer comes enriched with descriptive_name, currency_code, time_zone, manager flag, status. Use the returned customer_id (10 digits) in `cust

tools.name: google_ads_status
tools.description:
Without account: overview of all Google Ads MCCs and customer_ids. With account (and optional customer_id): details for that scope.

Bulk support: accepts customer_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: google_ads_account
tools.description:
Get Google Ads account info: name, currency, timezone for a customer (uses account + customer_id to resolve scope).

Bulk support: accepts customer_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: google_ads_campaigns
tools.description:
List Google Ads campaigns with status and budgets. Default (ALL) returns both ENABLED and PAUSED campaigns; pass status ENABLED or PAUSED to narrow. REMOVED (deleted) campaigns are excluded.

Bulk support: accepts customer_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: google_ads_today
tools.description:
Today Google Ads performance: cost, impressions, clicks, conversions, ROAS per campaign plus _summary.

Bulk support: accepts customer_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: google_ads_roas
tools.description:
ROAS for a date range (defaults to current month). Per-campaign cost, conversions, revenue, plus _summary.

Bulk support: accepts customer_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: google_ads_ads
tools.description:
List enabled ads with type, status, campaign name and ad_group_ad.policy_summary (approval_status, review_status, policy_topic_entries) — answers "why is my ad not serving?" without opening the Google Ads UI.

Bulk support: accepts customer_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: google_ads_performance
tools.description:
Daily performance breakdown: cost, impressions, clicks, conversions, revenue per day.

Bulk support: accepts customer_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: google_ads_changes
tools.description: Change history / audit log: who changed what in the account and when. Covers campaigns, ad groups, ads (headlines/descriptions/final URLs), keywords, budgets and bids, with the user_email who made each change, the client (web UI / API / bulk upload), the operation (CREATE/UPDATE/REMOVE), the changed

tools.name: google_ads_campaign_update_status
tools.description: Pause, enable or remove one or more Google Ads campaigns. REMOVED is irreversible. Pass campaign ids from google_ads_campaigns. Google rejects status changes on trial (draft/experiment) campaigns, which can only be changed in the Google Ads UI.

tools.name: google_ads_campaign_update_budget
tools.description:
Update the daily budget of a campaign. Pass the campaign id and the new amount in the account currency unit (R$50,50 -> 50.5; converted to micros internally).

Bulk support: accepts campaign_ids, customer_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: google_ads_ad_group_update_status
tools.description: Pause, enable or remove ad groups. REMOVED is irreversible.

tools.name: google_ads_ad_update_status
tools.description:
Pause, enable or remove ads. Each entry needs ad_group_id + ad_id because the ad resource is keyed by both (customers/X/adGroupAds/{ad_group_id}~{ad_id}).

Bulk support: accepts customer_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: google_ads_keyword_update_status
tools.description:
Pause, enable or remove keywords. Each entry needs ad_group_id + criterion_id (the keyword criterion id).

Bulk support: accepts customer_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: google_ads_keyword_update_bid
tools.description:
Update max CPC for one or more keywords. Bid in account currency unit (e.g. 1.5 = R$1,50).

Bulk support: accepts customer_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: google_ads_campaign_budget_create
tools.description:
Create a campaign_budget. Required to create a campaign. Amount is daily, in account currency unit (50 = R$50/day).

Bulk support: accepts customer_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: google_ads_campaign_create
tools.description: Create a Google Ads campaign. Defaults to channel_type=SEARCH, status=PAUSED (safe), bidding_strategy=MANUAL_CPC. Provide budget_id from google_ads_campaign_budget_create. Declares no EU political advertising by default (Reg 2024/900, required by Google). Only SEARCH, DISPLAY and SHOPPING can be cre

tools.name: google_ads_ad_group_create
tools.description:
Create an ad group inside a campaign. Default status ENABLED, type SEARCH_STANDARD. Optional cpc_bid as the ad-group-level default max CPC.

Bulk support: accepts campaign_ids, customer_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: google_ads_keyword_add
tools.description:
Add positive keywords to an ad group. Each keyword: { text, match_type, cpc_bid? }. match_type = EXACT | PHRASE | BROAD.

Bulk support: accepts ad_group_ids, customer_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: google_ads_negative_keyword_add
tools.description:
Add negative keywords at campaign or ad group scope. Pass scope + the matching target_id (campaign_id or ad_group_id).

Bulk support: accepts target_ids, customer_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: google_ads_responsive_search_ad_create
tools.description:
Create a Responsive Search Ad (RSA) inside an ad group. Headlines: 3-15 entries (each <= 30 chars). Descriptions: 2-4 entries (each <= 90 chars). final_urls required. Default status PAUSED.

Bulk support: accepts ad_group_ids, customer_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: google_ads_sitelinks
tools.description:
List sitelink assets in the account and where they are attached (campaign / account / ad group level), with each link's resource_name (pass it to google_ads_sitelink_remove) and status. Use to audit existing sitelinks before creating new ones.

Bulk support: accepts customer_ids for batched executio

tools.name: google_ads_sitelink_create
tools.description: Create sitelink extensions and attach them to a campaign (default), the whole account (scope=customer) or an ad group. A sitelink is a SitelinkAsset (its own link_text + final_url, optionally 2 description lines) linked to the scope — it is NOT the ad's display path (that is path1/path2 on the RSA).

tools.name: google_ads_sitelink_remove
tools.description:
Detach sitelinks from a campaign / account / ad group. Pass the link_resource_name(s) from google_ads_sitelinks. Removes only the association (the shared sitelink asset stays in the account library), so it is reversible by re-attaching.

Bulk support: accepts customer_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: report_bug

tools.name: toolkit_info
tools.description: Returns the current toolkit state: installed MCPs, their connection status, the accounts connected to each one, and how many catalog tools each exposes.
